cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Zápočet je udělen za aktivní účast ve výuce a vytvoření návrhu zadání diplomové práce v souladu s nařízením děkana 7/2023. Návrh zadání diplomové práce je formou nejen vlastního návrhu, ale je rozvinutý zejména v části metodika. Student povinně se svým vedoucím práce zkonzultuje metodiku a uvede nejméně 10 zdrojů, které jsou v metodice práce uvedeny a citovány v souladu s požadavky na vědecké publikace. Rozsah seminární práce činí 5 normostran.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to assist students in selecting a topic for their diploma thesis and to familiarize them with the requirements and attributes of creating scientifically oriented master's theses, including effective time management. Additionally, the student will gain competence in working with information sources.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The credit is awarded for active participation in the course and for preparing a draft of the master's thesis assignment in accordance with Dean's Directive 7/2023. The thesis assignment draft is not only based on the student's proposal but is primarily elaborated in the methodology section. The student is required to consult the methodology with their thesis supervisor and provide at least 10 sources, which must be included in the methodology and cited in accordance with the standards for scientific publications. The seminar paper should have a length of 5 standard pages (NM).
